subject: [PATCH v5 08/11] mm, swap: only charge physical swap entries

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch modifies how memory charge is handled for swap entries in Linux. It ensures that only physical swap entries are charged against a cgroup's swap, rather than all swap entries including zswap-backed and zero-filled pages. This change affects the behavior of memory.swap.current and allows cgroups to reclaim their anon memory even when memory.swap.max is set to 0. The patch also refactors the swap memcg operations into separate helpers for getting, recording, charging, uncharging, and putting swap entries.
